at: By day he trains in the backyard with a ring-pommel sword
alt: The magistrate shirtless in the backyard, training with a ring-pommel sword.

at: He peels the black robe off and sits in the heat with his chest bare
alt: The magistrate shirtless in the backyard hot spring — handsome, fit, black-pupil Korean face.

at: In the steam he is tormented by her
alt: In the steam the magistrate is tormented by lust for Wonganghami’s body — he will not invent her yes.

at: Forced yes tastes like ash to him
alt: Wonganghami refuses the handsome magistrate from loyalty; he does not force her.
The magistrate mauled by his own daughters driven mad by the evil fighting flower.

at: He tips the gray hood back
alt: Worm’s-eye: Hallakgungi unveils his disguise over the terrified third daughter — echoing the magistrate’s pose.

at: They sit in the rows until the light goes thin
alt: First union of Hallakgungi and his father in the flower-field garden — comb halves between them.

at: basket of flowers on his hip
alt: Hallakgungi arrives at the magistrate’s house in disguise with a basket of flowers.

at: His mouth is soft. His eyes are not.
alt: Worm’s-eye on the magistrate — soft mouth, black-pupil eyes that do not blink.
